topic_title: Value of Responsible Reduced-Risk Driving Practices
prompt: Why do driver education specialists reject the word 'accident' in favor of 'collision' or 'crash'?

options.text: 'Collision' is a legal term required strictly for commercial insurance litigation
State law fines motorists fifty dollars for using the word accident in police reports
'Crash' applies exclusively when vehicles travel at speeds over seventy miles per hour
'Accident' implies unpreventable chance, whereas crashes are predictable and preventable
